conditions.title: Grammar-data gate for Jim in the same admission (lexer half of Sol-19 step 4)
conditions.detail: Lexer::script_byte translates a lone CR only when the selected LexerGrammar's source-channel axis is TranslateAuto. Values: GRAMMAR_TCL84 and its 8.5-9.1 heirs TranslateAuto. GRAMMAR_JIM Preserve. The F5 trunk inherits TranslateAuto, documented as not decided by any oracle. Carry the axis through LexerConfig (from_grammar, with_grammar, grammar_over). Mirror it in the SpecTcl dialect_block vocabulary and the studio form, or add a GAPS entry. Add a jimsh-pinned Jim regression test.
conditions.failing_scenario_without_it: Jim grammar, Document bytes '#\r{\nputs reached\n'. jimsh 0.84 source succeeds and prints 'reached'. HEAD jim_script_syntax_tokens gives missing=None. Patched it gives missing=Some(b'{'), so script_image_is_complete flips true to false and the command_binding Jim WholeScript Direct parse records the source as Error.

conditions.title: Apply assertion-corrections.patch
conditions.detail: Three narrow, documented corrections. Each is a genuine contradiction of tclsh source for C Tcl document fixtures.

conditions.title: Contract text must name the channel-less auxiliary scanners as a tracked gap (or land step 2)
conditions.detail: These scanners have no channel and agree with the lexer only on boundary-normalised text: structural_index BracketIndex/BraceIndex, ranges::command_subst_close, word_parts::command_subst_close, the Grouper::close blank-line count, segmenter recovery and single_newline_gap, the E201 heuristics, the comment_line_starts line filter, and the line-keyed suppressions.

conditions.title: Owed validation
conditions.detail: cargo test -p tcl-lexer; the tcl-lsp-core, tcl-compiler and tcl-lsp-server suites; make rust-check. None has been executed.

residual_hazards: native_script_words::local_region_tokens slices the bytes, so a region ending between the CR and LF of a CRLF reads that CR as lone and gives a trailing EOL. Command structure is unchanged; EOL-presence predicates fail closed. Non-blocking.
JimNative parse_sep and parse_comment now stop at a lone CR on Document images (the Jim regression, condition 1).
Pre-existing: compiled Document script fragments moved to runtime eval (has_command_separator then EVAL_STK) are not CR-translated.

jim.lexer_can_know_dialect: yes, via LexerConfig built from the per-dialect LexerGrammar; no source-channel axis exists yet
jim.scope_of_regression: Core raw-text entry points: jim_script_syntax_tokens, jim_script_is_complete/script_image_is_complete, and Analyser on raw Jim text. The server, CLI and MCP boundaries already normalise every dialect (pre-existing).
jim.step4_in_same_admission: the lexer-side grammar gate: yes; the issuer-side part can follow

assertion_decisions.correction: Route the existing assertion to Lexer::with_bytes (NativeValue), keeping it, and add the Document expectation [Esc, Eol, Esc, Eol].
